# Slicing 3-D Arrays

#### Course: Python Numpy for Data Science

## Slicing 3-D Arrays

Similar to 2-D arrays, 3-D arrays in NumPy can also be sliced to access specific elements or subarrays.

The slicing syntax for 3-D arrays extends the concept of slicing in 2-D arrays.

```python
1import numpy as np
2
3# create a 3-D array
4array1 = np.arange(1, 9).reshape(2, 2, 2)
5
6# slicing the 3-D array
7entire_array = array1[:, :, :]    # slice the entire array
8print("\nEntire Array:")
9print(entire_array)
10
11second_matrix = array1[1, :, :]    # slice the second matrix
12print("\nSecond matrix:")
13print(second_matrix)
14
15second_row_each_matrix = array1[:, 1, :]    # slice the second row of each matrix
16print("\nSecond row of each matrix:")
17print(second_row_each_matrix)
18
19second_column_each_matrix = array1[:, :, 1]    # slice the second column of each matrix
20print("\nSecond column of each matrix:")
21print(second_column_each_matrix)
```

Output

```text
Entire Array:
[[[1 2]
  [3 4]]

 [[5 6]
  [7 8]]]

Second matrix:
[[5 6]
 [7 8]]

Second row of each matrix:
[[3 4]
 [7 8]]

Second column of each matrix:
[[2 4]
 [6 8]]
```

In this code, we are creating a 3-dimensional array arr using NumPy. It has a shape of (2, 2, 3), meaning it has 2 matrices, each with 2 rows and 3 columns.

Here,

#### array1[:, :, :]

slices the entire array. It selects all the matrices, rows, and columns, resulting in the same arr array.

![Slicing Entire 3D Array](data:image/png;base64,)

#### array1[1, :, :]

slices the second matrix. It selects all the rows and columns of the second matrix, resulting in the second_matrix array.

![Slicing Second Matrix from 3D Array](data:image/png;base64,)

#### array1[:, 1, :]

slices the second row of each matrix. It selects the second row from each matrix, resulting in the second_row_each_matrix array.

![Slicing Second Row from 3D Array](data:image/png;base64,)

#### array1[:, :, 1]

slices the second column of each matrix. It selects the second column from each matrix, resulting in the second_column_each_matrix array.

![Slicing Second Column from 3D Array](data:image/png;base64,)

![Idea Emoji](data:image/png;base64,)
